name: Golden Ten
summary: A Hearts-like reverse trick-taking game where players avoid red penalties and hunt the yellow 10.
rules_text: Played with 56 cards in four colors (red, yellow, green, black) ranked 14 high to 1 low. For 3-7 players, deal clockwise one at a time so each has equal cards; 1-2 leftover cards with 3, 5, or 6 players go to winner of first trick. Player left of dealer leads first trick. Must follow color if able, otherwise may play any card. Highest card of led color wins trick and leads next. After all tricks, score penalties: each red card = 1, red 5 = 5, red 10 = 10. Yellow 10 (Golden Ten) subtracts 10 from your penalty total, to minimum zero. Play six deals with rotating dealer; lowest total penalties wins.
rating_reason: Hearts-like reverse trick-taking, 3-7 players, clear avoid/win objectives
